subject: ISO27001 & FedRAMP posture — audit window and evidence owners
messages:
From: J. Smith <j.smith@acme-corp.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Audit window and evidence owners for Acme POC

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security team is scoping the control evidence requests for the planned POC and upcoming vendor assessment. Two quick asks so we can align schedules with our audit vendor (RegWorks):

1) Can you confirm Redwood's target ISO 27001 certification timeline (if any) and whether you expect an external audit in H2 2027?
2) We need a short list of control/evidence owners (who on Redwood will own evidence for Access Control, Change Management, Logging/Monitoring, and Data Retention).

We have a preliminary evidence matrix template attached — if you can return a populated version by next Wednesday (05/05) that would keep us on schedule for an early-June assessment.

Attachments: evidence-ask-template.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
J. Smith
Security Programs Lead — Acme Corp
security@acme-corp.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: J. Smith <j.smith@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 18:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit window and evidence owners for Acme POC

Hi J — appreciate the clear asks. Looping in Marissa, Rishi and Lauren to confirm owners and timeline. Quick answers up front while we coordinate the matrix:

- ISO 27001: We are targeting formal ISO 27001 certification preparedness by Q4 2027, with an internal readiness assessment in Q3. We do not have a finalized external audit date yet, but are aiming for a certification audit in November 2027.
- FedRAMP: We are in early scoping for a FedRAMP readiness path (low-impact first), with a readiness assessment planned if customers require it — timeline TBD and dependent on customer commitments.

Rishi / Lauren — can you take ownership of populating the attached evidence template for the four control families J called out and confirm whether we have existing artifacts (policies, runbooks, role lists, and sample logs) we can share? Also flag any gaps that would block a June window.

I will consolidate and get back to you and Acme by EOD Wednesday.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of Compliance Programs — Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-iso-map.pdf (pdf)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit window and evidence owners for Acme POC

On Tue, 27 Apr 2027 at 18:10, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com> wrote:
> Rishi / Lauren — can you take ownership of populating the attached evidence template for the four control families J called out and confirm whether we have existing artifacts (policies, runbooks, role lists, and sample logs) we can share? Also flag any gaps that would block a June window.

Short update from infra/compliance side:
- Access Control: Owner — Rishi Malhotra. We have the IAM owner lists, role definitions, and a short access-review report for Jan-Apr 2027. Will attach a sanitized copy to the matrix.
- Change Management: Owner — Lauren Bishop. Change request register + change-review minutes exist; we need to extract a month of approvals as a sample.
- Logging/Monitoring: Owner — Rishi. We can provide syslog/alerting screenshots and a 14-day sample of aggregated logs; need approval from infra ops to share redacted logs.
- Data Retention: Owner — Marissa Cole. Marissa to confirm retention schedule and sample data deletion tickets.

Blocking items for June assessment:
- Evidence packaging: preparing redacted log samples and extracting approvals will take ~6 business days.
- FedRAMP-specific artifacts: we do not yet have a FedRAMP System Security Plan (SSP) drafted — that would push a formal FedRAMP readiness assessment beyond June unless Acme can accept a narrower scoping.

Action items:
- Rishi: populate Access Control and Logging sections in evidence-ask-template.xlsx and attach redacted samples (ETA 05/04).
- Lauren: extract approved CR examples (ETA 05/03).
- Marissa: confirm retention schedule and attach tickets (ETA 05/03).

I can help with redaction guidance and will coordinate with Ops on log sampling.

Rishi

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: J. Smith <j.smith@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit window and evidence owners for Acme POC

Hi J — thanks for the patience. Per our internal sync below, here's the proposed plan so Acme and RegWorks can determine whether a June vendor assessment is viable: 

Proposed timeline and deliverables:
- By 05/03: Change Management samples and retention tickets (Lauren, Marissa)
- By 05/04: Access Control + Logging sections populated and redacted samples (Rishi)
- By 05/05: Consolidated evidence matrix returned to Acme (Mina)
- If the June assessment remains a hard requirement: accept that FedRAMP-specific artifacts (SSP) are not yet ready — we recommend scoping the June assessment to ISO-like controls only and scheduling a FedRAMP readiness discovery for July.

Attachments included for your review: audit-window-proposal-2027-05.pdf (proposal with suggested assessment scope) and evidence-ask-template.xlsx (populated in-progress). I've also shared a read-only Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Acme-Compliance-Roadmap-2027

Next steps for Acme: please confirm whether RegWorks can proceed with an ISO-scoped review in June or whether you need full FedRAMP coverage. If you need FedRAMP scope, we should shift the assessment to July and I will coordinate draft SSP artifacts and a readiness checklist.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Compliance Programs — Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
Attachment: audit-window-proposal-2027-05.pdf (pdf)
